name: ir_activity_led
description: Indicate IR remote activity via GPIO or built-in LED: blink LED a few times on command received
author: Andrew Pono

volumio_info.details: Indicate IR remote activity via GPIO or built-in LED for Volumio 4 by Andrew Pono.
